$comment: The AndroidX samples pin for :samples-catalog. See docs/design/ANDROIDX_SAMPLES.md. `ref` is a COMMIT SHA and never a branch, so a render is reproducible and an upstream bump is a reviewable diff. `artifactVersion` is the AndroidX material3 version whose @sample set matches the Compose Multiplatform artifact this repo compiles against — derived, not guessed, and re-derived by scripts/samples-drift.mjs on every run: when CMP moves, the check fails and names the version to bump to. `paths` are subtrees of the upstream repository, fetched with a blobless sparse clone (13 MB, not the multi-GB whole tree).
refDescription: androidx-main at the time of the import
